feed.title: RVA Bike Feed: Fall Line Trail

entry.title: Fall Line Trail, October 7
entry.content:
From Fall Line Trail



Years ago, Sports Backers helped plant the seed for the Fall Line, and today, we got to watch that seed grow into shovels in the ground.
 
Six miles of the trail are already open and in use, and the turnout at this morning’s groundbreaking showed what’s coming next: community advocates, project staff, and government leaders, all showing up for 10 more miles that will connect Petersburg, Colonial Heights, and Chesterfield County by winter 2028. That kind of support is what turns a vision into miles people can actually ride and walk.
 
We’ve been proud to help lay the foundation, but the momentum from here belongs to this community and the leaders who keep showing up for it. We can’t wait to see where it goes.
